caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a curved backrest and an ornate central splat featuring symmetrical cutout designs. The chair's backrest is a medium brown color with gradual shading to indicate depth and wood grain. The seat of the chair is dark, almost black, suggesting a cushioned surface with subtle folds implying softness. The chair has four legs, also brown with a similar woodgrain texture, and each leg curves outward slightly. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, drawing focus solely to the chair. Near the lower right of the chair is a small red mark followed by the initials "M.A.R.S."
title: Chair
